name: Instructions for Lasting Agony
text:
This worn and stained manual emits a chill when opened.

---
Activate—Excruciating Spell 1 (manipulate, spellshape, void)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect If your next action is to Cast a prepared void Spell that allows a saving throw, you warp and twist the energy of the spell to cause intense pain. If the target fails its saving throw against the spell, it becomes Sickened 1 by the pain.
